d.t: Sodium silicate / water based based transparent surface hardener, dust proofer, densifier and impregnating sealer for concrete
d.s: Sikafloor CureHard-24 is a one part, clear sodium silicate based liquid to harden and provide an impregnating seal fresh or hardened concrete.
a: Improved chemical and abrasion resistance compared to untreated concrete
Good penetration - designed to pentrate, not provide a surface seal
us: Horizontal old or new concrete surfaces, where a hard surface with light to moderate abrasion resistance is required e.g. warehouses, industrial plants, stores, shopping malls, parking structures, service stations, hangars etc.
as an impreganting sealer on concrete slabs where no specific curing efficiency or standards are required
Suitable for interior or exterior applications as an impregating sealer.
As a desifier in the process of grinding and polishing concrete.
Suitable for protection against ingress (Principle 1, method 1.2 of EN 1504-9)
Suitable for physical resistance (Principle 5, method 5.2 of EN 1504-9)

Hardened / old concrete Surfaces must be sound, open textured, clean, free from frost, laitance, surface water, oils, grease, coatings, all loosely adhering particles and other surface contaminants. If in doubt apply a test area first. Note that Sikafloor CureHard-24 used a a general sealer will not penetrate burnished or fully polished concrete and is not suitable for this appliction. For best results with new concrete floors wait for 7–14 days after placement or until after cement has sufficiently hydrated prior to treatment with Sikafloor CureHard-24.

Hardened / old concrete The substrate must be prepared by suitable cleaning method such as high pressure water cleaning or by ride-on cleaning machines. Allow drying prior to application. All dust, dirt, loose and friable material must be completely removed from all surfaces before application of the product, preferably by brush and / or vacuum.

Hardened Concrete Full hardening - densifying process Apply in a continuous film using a high volume low pressure spray unit. To ensure maximum penetration, scrub material into the surface with a soft bristle broom or floor-scrubbing machine (min. 30 minutes), until the material begins to gel and becomes slippery. Wet the material slightly with a water spray and rework it into the surface for another 10 to 20 minutes. After this process, rinse the floor and remove any excess material using a squeegee, wet vacuum or mop. On porous, rough-textured or broom-finished surfaces, a second coat may be required. For large surfaces and higher placing rates, mechanical equipment such as ride-on cleaning machines can be also used to place, brush in and remove the excess material from the surface. Thanks to proceeding chemical reaction the rate of water-tightness increases gradually, whereas maximum sealing and hardening effect occurs earliest after 7 days. Gloss of the surface gradually increases during 30 to 90 days depending upon cleaning frequency. As a densifier in grind/polish system Apply Product by spray or squeegee to the surface at the 80 grit stage of grinding. Two applications are recommended. If product is applied at the polishing stage uneven colour may result. Do not use Sikafloor CureHard-24 as a final sealer on polished, finished floors as a sealer - it will not penetrate and will result in an unsatisfactory outcome that will have to be stripped off. As a general sealer Apply with manual spray equipment or roller at a rate of approx 8-10m2 per litre depending on the porosity of the substrate. Apply evenly without any excess product or pooling on the surface. Two coats recommended. Do not allow excess product to remain on the surface - whitening or stickiness of the excess product may occur and leave discolouration. Do not apply as a general sealer on fully burnished/closed/dense concrete surfaces as it will be unable to pentrate.
Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be mechanically removed.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Store in original container. Keep in a well-ventilated place. Containers which are opened must be carefully resealed and kept upright to prevent leakage. Observe label precautions. Store in accordance with local regulations.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). For personal protection see section 8. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: No special measures required. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
